scope: UX, keyboard navigation, mobile failure resilience and N-1 compatibility fixtures (Requirement N33)
provenance: repository-authored synthetic test fixtures; no third-party data or customer traffic

fixtures.description: Mobile 360px viewport reference workflow execution constraint asserting zero root horizontal overflow and accessible touch targets.
Desktop 1440px viewport reference workflow execution constraint asserting full sequential keyboard navigation and wide-screen grid readability.
Tabular equivalent representation for the six reference workflow stages, providing WCAG-compliant accessible tabular structure alongside the card list.
N-1 schema version (v1) export fixture demonstrating backward-compatible workflow report ingestion and verification.
Tampered export fixture with invalid schema version and corrupted payload structure that must fail closed on ingestion.
Interrupted execution fixture simulating client abort or network timeout during stage execution, verifying fail-safe UI recovery.
Provider outage fixture asserting fail-closed denial when the identity provider or decision engine is unreachable, while preserving active authority.
